drg.description: Simple Pneumonia and Pleurisy with CC

timeline.text: Chest x-ray: right lower lobe opacity

notes.text:
HISTORY AND PHYSICAL. Chart, labs and overnight events reviewed. 68-year-old male admitted for community-acquired pneumonia. Admission data:
Day 0: labs bilirubin 0.6, creatinine 1-1.21, hemoglobin 13.8-14, platelets 288-290, sodium 141, wbc 7.9-8.3; vitals dbp 71-74, heart_rate 69-74, map 87-89, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 14-16, sbp 116-120, spo2 96-97, temp 36.7-37
Day 0 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV; Chest x-ray: right lower lobe opacity
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia. Acute kidney injury.

PROGRESS NOTE, hospital day 1. Patient seen and examined at bedside. Data:
Day 1: labs creatinine 1.38-1.53, hemoglobin 13.7-14, platelets 286-294, sodium 141, wbc 7.7-7.9; vitals dbp 71-74, heart_rate 68-74, map 87-90, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 14-15, sbp 116-122, spo2 96-97, temp 36.8-36.9
Day 1 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV; Lactated Ringer's 1 L IV bolus
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia. Acute kidney injury ruled out. Continue current management.

DISCHARGE SUMMARY. 68-year-old male, length of stay 3 days. Hospital course: treated per the plan above with daily labs and vital signs; stable for discharge. Medications reconciled and return precautions reviewed. Discharge diagnoses: Community-acquired pneumonia. Acute kidney injury ruled out. Follow up with primary care in one week. Patient seen and examined at bedside.
